home.title: Homassy
home.description: Manage your household inventory, shopping lists, and share everything with your family.

userAuth.title: User Authentication
userAuth.description: Passwordless sign-in with email verification codes or passkeys (Face ID, Touch ID, device PIN). Secure session-based authentication.

familyManagement.title: Family Management
familyManagement.description: Create families, invite members with a code, and manage shared data together.

productsInventory.title: Products and Inventory
productsInventory.description: Track products and inventory: add, move, consume, and mark favorites.

shoppingLists.title: Shopping Lists
shoppingLists.description: Shared shopping lists with items, quick purchase feature that adds directly to inventory.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Store shops and home storage locations; modify multiple items at once.

barcodeQuality.title: Barcode and Data Quality
barcodeQuality.description: Barcode scanning and validation, Open Food Facts data, secure image uploads.

passkey.title: Passkey & Email Sign-in
passkey.description: Sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, or your device PIN — no password required. Email verification codes are always available as a fallback.

pwa.title: Progressive Web App
pwa.description: Install Homassy on any phone or desktop directly from the browser. No app store needed — updates happen automatically.

notifications.title: Push Notifications
notifications.description: Receive daily alerts at 7 AM about products expiring within 14 days, weekly summaries every Monday, and real-time notifications when new items are added to a shared family shopping list by another member.

activityFeed.title: Family Activity Feed
activityFeed.description: A live timeline of everything happening in your household — who bought what, added a product, or consumed an item.

highlights.title: Why Homassy?
highlights.description: Built for real households, with privacy and collaboration at its core.

openSource.title: Open Source & Self-hosted
openSource.description: Homassy is AGPL-3.0 licensed. Run it on your own server and keep full control of your data.

multiLanguage.title: 3 Languages
multiLanguage.description: Full support for English, German, and Hungarian, with more languages planned for the future.

familyFirst.title: Designed for Families
familyFirst.description: Shared inventory, shopping lists, and activity feeds — everything syncs in real time across all family members.

cta.title: Ready to organise your home?
cta.description: Join Homassy and bring order to your household inventory and shopping.

stats.title: Homassy in Numbers
stats.description: Real data from households using Homassy every day.
